irisRoundness.description: Roundness of the iris, from 0 (polygon) to 1 (circle)

highlightGain.description: Additional brightness of highlights, from 0 to 1

highlightThreshold.description: Minimum luminance for highlight gain, from 0 to 1

highlightSaturation.description: Saturation of added highlight brightness, from 0 to 1

repeatEdgePixels.description: Repeat edge pixels outside the source instead of sampling transparency

samples.description: Number of aperture samples, from 16 to 2048
